text:
Silence. Here is ha hecho already of night,
        already tras of the cementerio is was the sun;
        here is is llorando to mil pupilas:
        not vuelvas; already murió my heart.
        Silence. Here already all is vestido
        of pain riguroso; and arde apenas,
        as a mal kerosene, esta pasión.


        Primavera vendrá. Cantarás «Eva»
        from a minuto horizontal, from a
        hornillo in that arderán the nardos of Eros.
        ¡Forja there your perdón for the poeta,
        that ha of dolerme still,
        as clavo that cierra a ataúd!


        But… a night of lirismo, your
        buen seno, your mar red
        is azotará with olas of quince años,
        to the see lejos, aviado with recuerdos
        my corsario bajel, my ingratitud.
        Después, your manzanar, your labio dándose,
        and that is aja for mí for the vez última,
        and that muere sangriento of amar mucho,
        as a croquis pagano of Jesús.


        ¡Amada! And cantarás;
        and ha of vibrar the femenino in my soul,
        as in a enlutada catedral.
